claim_summary: The paper contributes Tree-of-Evidence, a learned evidence-bottleneck and beam-search wrapper for faithful explanations of multimodal predictions, but no LLM-side or agent-harness module in this survey's scope.

claim_evidence.quote: We introduce Tree-of-Evidence (ToE), an inference-time search algorithm that frames interpretability as a discrete optimization problem.

task_performance.quote: ToE retains 98.5–99.3% of full-model AUROC at k = 5 across all four MIMIC-IV tasks

notes: The current card has no modules and marks the work out of scope; this is supported by the packet. Its zero-shot LLM comparison is a baseline, while ToE itself is an interpretability wrapper around learned multimodal classifiers rather than an LLM capability or agent runtime. No module satisfies R1 for this survey.
